source: Owner direct chat after discussion of duplicate executor, reviewer and controller checks
owner_message_original: Давай сделаем четче, уменьшим дублирование в работе
owner_message_english_translation: Let's make it clearer and reduce duplication in the work.
accepted_proposal_context: The controller proposed keeping one primary independent technical reviewer for substantive changes and controller task acceptance, instead of a second complete technical review. Small obvious low-impact changes can use executor self-checks and controller acceptance unless independent review is explicitly required.
decision: Clarify and apply standing review responsibilities to reduce duplicate work while retaining controller accountability and required acceptance gates.

responsibilities.executor: Implement, self-check directly affected behavior and provide candidate-specific evidence and limits.
responsibilities.independent_reviewer: Own technical review of substantive changes and verification of findings; inspect the actual relevant candidate and reuse credible applicable executor evidence. Additional specialists cover distinct criteria only.
responsibilities.controller: Own scope, dispatch, progress, correction coordination, evidence applicability, finding closure, task acceptance, administration, closure commit and owner handoff without a second full technical review.

repeat_check_rule: Record a concrete relevant candidate change, evidence gap, contradictory result or uncovered risk before repeating a check or deepening controller investigation. Limit work to affected criteria and related transitions; retain applicable passing evidence with its original identity.
preserved_requirements: Explicit independent visual review and owner design/play acceptance gates
Owner-only review of the protagonist concept batch
Max reasoning and standard speed for executors and reviewers
One production writer, one heavy workload and existing dispatch boundaries
Focused verification and local task-scoped closure commits
Historical evidence and unrelated owner changes
scope: Standing future workflow and relevant existing administrative guidance/profile instructions. No gameplay changes, successor execution, new art production or retrospective acceptance are authorized by this record.
